name: eig
expr: e1 = sort(eig(A)); e2 = sort(eig(D)); ei = sort(eig(eye(4))); eg = sort(real(eig(G))); [V, M] = eig(A); err = max(max(abs(A*V - V*M))); ev = sort(eig(A,'vector')); dm = sort(diag(eig(A,'matrix'))); gp = sort(eig(As, Bs)); [Vg, Dg] = eig(As, Bs); errg = max(max(abs(As*Vg - Bs*Vg*Dg))); [Vw, Dw, Ww] = eig(A); werr = max(max(abs(Ww'*A - Dw*Ww'))); wveq = max(max(abs(Ww - Vw))); wsum = sum(sum(abs(Ww))); [Vn, Dn, Wn] = eig(N); wnerr = max(max(abs(Wn'*N - Dn*Wn'))); wnsum = sum(sum(abs(Wn))); wn1 = norm(Wn(:,1));
comment: Sig: e = eig(A) | [V,D] = eig(A) | [V,D,W] = eig(A) | eig(A,'vector'|'matrix') | eig(A,B). Symmetric: classical Jacobi. General: characteristic polynomial via Souriau-Faddeev + roots(). Left eigenvectors W (fixed 2026-06-05, bugs/linalg/eig-left-vectors.md): W'*A = D*W', the right eigenvectors of A' reordered to D's eigenvalue order and normalized to unit 2-norm; for symmetric A, W == V. W column signs may differ from MATLAB (eig sign convention), so W is validated sign/order-agnostically: the relation residual werr/wnerr ~ 0, symmetric W==V (wveq ~ 0), unit-norm columns (wn1=1), and sum(abs(W)) (wsum/wnsum, invariant under column permutation + sign). Generalized eig(A,B) reduces to B\A. 'vector'/'matrix'/eig(A,B) queue-cleared 2026-05-29. Sort applied for order-agnostic eigenvalue comparison.
